newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Eurostat rulings have no effect on Germany - EU.
newsitem.headline: Eurostat rulings have no effect on Germany - EU.

text.p: Eurostat's rulings on Monday on various accounting issues related to economic and monetary union (EMU) will have no effect on how Germany is judged to have met the Maastricht criteria, EU officials said.
But the European Union's Luxembourg-based statistics office would be looking at a number of issues that could affect Germany and reporting back at the end of February, they said.
"There aren't any effects on Germany from the eight cases (reported on Monday), but there should be some in the next package," one official told reporters at a news conference.
Eurostat would be looking at reporting of state guarantees, pre-financing of public works by the private sector and so-called euro-taxes designed to help countries meet the EMU criteria, he said.
